description: Explicit user-level RBAC for DApp economies: ordinary users can use/run DApps; DApp developers can author with dapp:develop; DApp managers can manage DApp lifecycle/membership with dapp:manage; platform operators remain JWT-only operator:admin. Tightens DApp policies so logged-in JWT users are not implicitly DApp authors and API-key DApp scopes remain bounded by the owning user's current role.
phase: All six acceptance criteria are satisfied in code and covered by tests; the three spec follow-ons (per-DApp membership table, role-management UI, federation projection) were always out of scope for this track.

shipped_evidence.note: Status was still `in_progress` with phase 'implementation swarm started' long after the swarm landed. Corrected on the evidence below; the track had no plan.md, which is why nothing recorded the finish.
